intent: Eight original family-story invitation tasks require entered 45-minute duration, opposite Tao/noodles and Nora/dumplings matching, distinguish absence of obligation from prohibition, connect optional photographs with permission conditions, ask about particular experiences, respect a declined personal question and reject unsupported country-wide rules. Fresh weekend-story transfer changes duration to 50 minutes and uses partly correct time/scope combinations.

items.material:
A FAMILY FOOD STORY EVENING
The event runs in the school hall from 17:20 to 18:05.
Tao will talk about the vegetable noodles his family made on Friday.
Nora will describe the dumplings her family made on Sunday.
Nobody has to bring food.
Speakers may bring a photograph to support their story.
If other people appear in it, get their permission before showing it.
Different families may do things differently, even in the same town.
Ask about the speaker's own experience, such as 'When does your family make this?'
Do not turn one family's meal into a rule about everyone in a country.
If a visitor does not want to answer a personal question, move on politely.
The aim is to learn from particular experiences, not to make a single rule for millions of people.
